name: St. Francis II: GYM 2016
information:
The cost of registration will be $6 for the first event and $3 for every additional event, with FMC costing $4. Tentative events are free (if they happen). If you do not pre-register by April 17th, there will be $4 added to the fee. Spectators are free. For St. Francis High School students and staff members, the registration fee will be waived.
If you are one of the first 30 competitors to sign up for St. Francis, your cost for registration will be $4 for the first event and $1 for every additional event, with FMC costing $2. If you are the 31st-60th person to sign up, your cost will be $5 for the first event and $2 for every additional event, with FMC costing $3.
